name: @absolutejs/secure-messaging-postgres
description: Tenant-scoped atomic PostgreSQL SecureMessagingStore for AbsoluteJS.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --root src --sourcemap --target=browser --external @absolutejs/secure-messaging && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public
